channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Teacher and Student Die During Iowa Field Trip
item.description: A fifth-grade teacher and a 10-year-old student died during a school field trip at Lake MacBride State Park in Iowa. The incident occurred on a field trip for fifth-grade students. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Watchdog Urges Met Police to Investigate Itself Over Suspect's Arrest
item.description: A police watchdog has recommended that the Metropolitan Police investigate itself concerning the arrest of a suspect identified as the 'Putney pusher'. The watchdog's statement indicates a call for internal review of the arrest procedures. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: E. Jean Carroll Awarded Damages from Donald Trump
item.description: E. Jean Carroll has received damages from Donald Trump following a protracted legal dispute. The court battle concluded with Carroll being awarded the compensation she sought. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Doctor and Wife Attacked in Sleep; Doctor Dies
item.description: A doctor in Pittsburgh was killed while sleeping, and his wife was also attacked during the incident. Police stated that an intruder allegedly attacked the couple as they slept. The doctor, who was described as "loved by all" and "kind… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Court Upholds Pentagon's Security Risk Label for Anthropic
item.description: A U.S. Appeals Court has upheld the Pentagon's designation of Anthropic, an artificial intelligence company, as a security risk. The court's decision affirms the Pentagon's assessment of Anthropic as a supply chain risk. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jury Awards $11 Million in Wrongful Death Suit Against LAPD
item.description: A jury has awarded $11 million to the family of a man who was killed by Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) officers during a mental health crisis. The lawsuit was filed by the man's children. The incident occurred in South Los Angeles. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: North Korea Accused of $387 Million Crypto Theft from Bitget
item.description: The cryptocurrency exchange Bitget has been targeted in a hack, with North Korea accused of plundering an estimated $387 million to $390 million. This incident is described as the year's biggest crypto attack. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Boy Noah Woods died after exiting play area through fence gap, inquest told
item.description: An inquest heard that Noah Woods died after exiting a play area through a gap in the fence and was subsequently found in a lake. The details emerged during an inquest hearing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Teenager killed in London road accident named
item.description: A 16-year-old girl has been named and pictured following her death after being hit by a minicab on her way to a private school in north London. Her family has paid tribute to her. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: GO Train Service Resumes After Delays on Lakeshore West Line
item.description: GO train service on the Lakeshore West line resumed Friday morning after experiencing significant delays. The delays were caused by a person being struck near Exhibition GO station. The transit agency confirmed the resumption of service. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: MapQuest GM Drove into Lake Ontario Following App Directions
item.description: The General Manager of MapQuest, who was not named, drove his vehicle into Lake Ontario after following directions provided by the MapQuest application. He described the decision to proceed despite the directions leading into the water as… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kazakhstan: 14 Service Members Die in Caspian Sea Incident
item.description: Fourteen Kazakh service members have died after being swept out to sea during military exercises in the Caspian Sea. Seventeen service members were involved in the incident. Senior Kazakh officials have been detained in connection with the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Wisconsin Frat Leaders Arrested in Alleged Hazing Incident
item.description: Authorities in Wisconsin arrested fraternity leaders after discovering approximately 30 pledges in a basement described as filthy and sweltering. The pledges were found injured and partially clothed, covered in condiments and other food… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Sydney Man Faces 115 New Child Abuse Charges
item.description: Hamish Alexander Edward Tait, an alleged childcare abuser in Sydney, has been charged with an additional 115 offenses. He is described as Australia's most prolific alleged daycare abuser. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Suspects in Paris Rugby Star Murder Ask Forgiveness Ahead of Verdict
item.description: In a Paris court on Friday, Loik Le Priol, a primary suspect in the 2022 murder of Argentine rugby player Federico Martin Aramburu, requested forgiveness from the victim's family. Verdicts are expected for four suspects, including Le Priol… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Explosion in Athens building injures three, five missing
item.description: An explosion occurred in a two-story building in Athens' historic Plaka district, near the Acropolis. The blast caused the building to collapse. At least three people were injured, and five are reported missing. The fire department… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Manchester City Found Guilty of Financial Rule Breaches
item.description: Manchester City has reportedly been found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules, with charges related to 115 offenses. All but one charge has reportedly been upheld. The specific punishment for these breaches is still pending… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Volkswagen recalls 2.86 million vehicles globally for steering issue
item.description: Volkswagen is recalling approximately 2.86 million vehicles worldwide due to a potential steering failure risk. The recall affects VW brand vehicles and Audi models manufactured between 2013 and 2024. A company spokesman stated the recall… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Ethiopia's Tigray Region Faces Internet, Phone Disruptions Amid Renewed Fighting
item.description: Internet and phone networks have been disrupted in Ethiopia's war-hit Tigray region following renewed fighting. The civil war in Tigray had previously led to the region being completely cut off from the outside world. Ethiopia's military… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court allows US voter database use for citizenship checks
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has lifted restrictions on a federal database of voters, allowing the Trump administration to use it to check the citizenship of voters. The administration claimed the database, known as SAVE, would combat voting by… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Chhattisgarh Churches Post 'Enter At Own Risk' Notices Amid Backlash Fears
item.description: Churches in Chhattisgarh have posted notices stating 'enter at own risk' for non-Christians, amidst fears of a Hindutva backlash. This action follows the enactment of an anti-conversion law in the state. The notices suggest a climate of… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: BJP Leader Madhavi Latha Barred From Entering Bagalkot District
item.description: BJP leader Madhavi Latha was prevented from entering Bagalkot district for a month. Authorities cited concerns over law and order during a Ganapati idol immersion procession. The order was issued by the Bagalkot District Magistrate. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Reserves Order on Sambhal Mosque Survey Pleas
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has reserved its order on petitions challenging a survey conducted in the Sambhal mosque-temple dispute. The court's decision will determine the next steps in the legal proceedings related to the dispute. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court dismisses PIL seeking Hindi as official court language
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has dismissed a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) that sought to make Hindi an official language for the court. The court stated that language cannot be imposed by an order. The PIL was rejected, with one report… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Telangana Govt Releases Funds for Hospital Renovation After Infant Deaths
item.description: The Telangana government has released Rs 11.1 crore for the renovation of RIMS hospital, specifically for the Sick Newborn Care Unit (SNCU). This decision follows an incident where five infants died in a fire at the hospital. The funds are… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Speeding Car Collides with Multiple Vehicles in Ludhiana
item.description: A speeding car collided with five other vehicles in Ludhiana, Punjab. A motorcyclist was thrown approximately 15 to 30 feet into the air following the impact. The incident was captured on CCTV, showing a frightening scene. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: NEET SS Counselling Special Round Announced After SC Order
item.description: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has announced a Special Stray Vacancy Round for NEET SS Counselling 2025. This follows a Supreme Court order and a reduction in the qualifying percentile from 50th to 30th. The round is for vacant… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Former TMC Leader Ajit Maity Arrested on Extortion Charges
item.description: Ajit Maity, a former leader of the Trinamool Congress (TMC) in West Bengal, has been arrested on charges of extortion. The arrest is reportedly linked to an alleged money-for-posts scheme. Maity faces political arrests amid ongoing… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi High Court orders police to allot protest venue to bank union
item.description: The Delhi High Court has directed the Delhi Police to decide on a venue for a protest by a bank employees union. The union had petitioned the court seeking permission to hold a peaceful dharna at Jantar Mantar or another suitable location… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi High Court Orders Protection, Takedown of Deepfake Image with PM Modi
item.description: The Delhi High Court has ordered police protection for a woman who alleged that leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) circulated a deepfake image of her with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The court also directed the takedown of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court hears Tarun Tejpal's appeal against rape conviction
item.description: India's Supreme Court has issued a notice seeking a response from the Goa government regarding journalist Tarun Tejpal's appeal against his conviction in a 2013 rape case. Tejpal was sentenced to 10 years of rigorous imprisonment. His… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Propriety Questions Raised Over Justice SC Sharma's Son's Role
item.description: Questions of propriety have arisen concerning Justice S.C. Sharma, whose son appeared in a case involving the Election Commission of India (ECI) and Medha Roopam. The son's appearance in a case heard by his father has led to scrutiny… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: AFSPA Extended in Manipur, Nagaland, Arunachal for Six Months
item.description: The Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act (AFSPA) has been extended for six months in parts of Manipur, Nagaland, and Arunachal Pradesh. The decision follows a review of the law and order situation in these northeastern states. In Manipur, the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Four Naga civilians killed by militants near Myanmar border in Manipur
item.description: Four Naga civilians were found dead near the Indo-Myanmar border in Manipur's Kamjong district. The victims, identified as Tangkhul Naga men, were discovered with multiple bullet wounds. Local reports allege that Myanmar-based extremists… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Air India Pilot Suspended After Failing Alcohol Test in Zurich
item.description: An Air India pilot was suspended after failing a pre-flight breathalyzer test for alcohol in Zurich before a flight to Delhi on September 6. The pilot was removed from duty. This incident follows a previous report of a pilot failing a test… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Protests and Legal Challenges Erupt Over Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
item.description: Student leaders and activists were detained during a protest at Jantar Mantar against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The Congress party organized nationwide protests demanding his resignation, with some activists, including… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 16 · Right 5.

item.title: Granite Baron Veeramani Arrested in Chennai Child Abuse Case
item.description: Chennai police have arrested granite mining baron Veeramani and two associates in connection with a child abuse case. Months prior, police had filed a closure report in the same case. The News Minute reported that hours after their report… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: IIT Bombay Faces Scrutiny Over Student Suicide Response and Campus Issues
item.description: Following the suicide of student Sahil Wakode, IIT Bombay initially deleted an apology related to the incident, later reposting it after public backlash. Police have recorded statements from 20 individuals and are attempting to access… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: Calcutta HC Protects Journalists Over 'Saffron Hooliganism' Headline
item.description: The Calcutta High Court has protected journalists from Anandabazar Patrika from arrest in connection with a headline that used the phrase 'saffron hooliganism'. The court's order provides interim protection against coercive action. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Four Detained After Video of Girl's Harassment Surfaces in Bihar
item.description: Four individuals have been detained following the emergence of a video depicting the alleged harassment of a girl in Bihar. The incident, which occurred in Samastipur district, has drawn comparisons to a previous case in Jamui. Reports… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 10 · Right 4.
